public_sources.bound_semantics: Riak documents vector clocks as causal history metadata that can detect descendant relationships and concurrent updates; unresolved concurrent values become siblings rather than being silently ordered.
A vector V is componentwise <= V' when each component is <=; neither vector dominating the other denotes concurrency.

chat_native_reduction.classification_rule: older if event_vector <= current_vector and not equal; newer if current_vector <= event_vector and not equal; concurrent if neither dominates
chat_native_reduction.authority_rule: vector order classifies causality only; it never auto-promotes an assignment without independent terminal qualification
chat_native_reduction.duplicate_rule: role-local semantic key guard is separate from vector-clock semantics

trace_results.effect: eligible for requalification only; no auto-promotion
semantic-key guard prevents a second effect
may enter independent qualification; still no authority bypass

control_results.control: treat CON as newer because it arrived last
collapse same assignment labels across distinct vectors

credit_rule: At most one role-local credit after exact terminal readback; this file creation alone earns zero credit.
scope_limit: Fixed two-component role-local causal-order trace only. No production distributed-systems correctness or optimizer-superiority claim.
